svg.title: USDe supply against the ENA fee switch milestones, January 1, 2024 to October 12, 2026
svg.desc: Two lines, USDe's total supply on Ethereum at the end of each day and its 14 day trailing average, from January 1, 2024 to October 12, 2026, in billions of USDe, with dashed lines at the fee switch milestones of 7.5, 10 and 15 billion. Day-end supply peaked at 14.82 billion on October 3, 2025. The 14 day average was at or above 7.5 billion from August 3, 2025 to November 28, 2025. On October 12, 2026 day-end supply was 4.77 billion and the 14 day average 4.87 billion.
svg.text: USDe's 14 day average supply had to rise 54% to reach the first ENA buyback milestone
USDe's total supply on Ethereum at the end of each UTC day, January 1, 2024 to October 12, 2026, in billions
14 day average at or above 7.5 billion
